notes: The admin and README now ship in eleven languages (Italian, Russian, Turkish, and Japanese join the lineup), LinkBreeze publishes first-party CasaOS, Runtipi, and Unraid app-store packaging, and Settings gains an update status card showing the installed version against the latest GitHub and website releases with a one-click Recheck. Importing a Linktree page no longer pulls Linktree's own affiliate links, dependency updates resolve the outstanding Dependabot alerts, and a security fix closes update-check server actions that skipped the demo guard on public demo instances.
